prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip, and it already shows Mai running through the inside of the fantasy gate (the teal tunnel of floating monitors). Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame.

[Generation Goal] 5 seconds, 1 continuous shot, no cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. A HIGH, almost top-down shot looking down the long tunnel INSIDE the fantasy gate: Mai, small in the centre of the frame, runs away from camera along the glowing path toward the bright light at the far end. Clean air around her: NO smoke, NO dust and NO mist trail behind her or under her feet.

[References] @Video1: style, world and this tunnel. @Image1: the INSIDE of the fantasy gate, this IS the location: a long cyan-teal tunnel whose walls and ceiling are made of dark twisted roots and cables, with many floating glowing white and pale-teal monitors drifting in the air along the walls; a path runs down its middle. @Image2 = MAI ONLY (design only, re-render in Mai's 3D style): girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar, a red neckerchief; navy pleated skirt; white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack.

[Style Lock] ONE single render style for every character and creature: exactly the premium stylized 3D CG look of @Video1 and of Mai as she appears in @Video1. The character reference images are DESIGN ONLY (face shape, hair, costume, colours, props); many of them are drawn in other styles (pencil sketch, watercolour, flat 2D, outlined illustration, paper texture): IGNORE their drawing style completely and never copy outlines, sketch lines, watercolour washes, flat shading or paper grain. Re-render every person as a 3D character from the same film as Mai: the same proportion system and stylisation (rounded soft volumes, slightly large expressive eyes with catchlights, small nose, simplified features), the same skin shading and subsurface warmth, the same cloth and hair materials, the same lighting response, film grain and level of detail. Adults stay adult proportions (7-7.5 heads) but share Mai's stylisation. Nobody may look like a different art style, a 2D drawing, a realistic human or a different film.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 1 person in this clip. Nobody else exists in this clip: no wolf, no villains, no other people, no animals.
1. Mai (@Image2): running away from camera, small in the centre of the frame.

[No Blending] Mai (@Image2) keeps only her own school uniform and sky-blue backpack; nothing from the tunnel merges into her.

[Composition, LOCKED to the reference frame] HIGH camera far above and behind Mai, looking steeply down the tunnel (about 60 degrees down), 35 mm: the dark root-and-cable tunnel walls frame the LEFT and RIGHT thirds of the frame and curve together above like a dark vignette; a vertical band of light runs down the centre of the frame: the floor path, bright and pale cyan-teal near the top of the frame where the tunnel ends in a bright glow, darker near the bottom. Floating monitors glow along both walls, a few drifting in the air above the path. Mai (@Image2) is SMALL, a little below the centre of the frame, seen from above and behind (top of her black bob, backpack, shoulders, legs), running UP the frame toward the light; her long thin shadow stretches straight DOWN the frame toward the camera. The air between Mai and the light is clear.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered]
Shot 1 (0-5 s), 1 person visible (Mai, small, from above and behind): ONE slow forward drift of the high camera that follows Mai at the same height and angle, keeping her near the centre and slightly shrinking as she runs on. Mai runs steadily along the path toward the bright end of the tunnel, backpack bouncing, hair and skirt bouncing with each small step; her long shadow slides along under her; floating monitors drift gently past on both sides; the bright glow at the end of the tunnel pulses softly. Her feet touch a clean floor: no smoke, no dust, no mist kicked up anywhere.

[Running Style] Mai runs the way a small, delicate little girl runs: graceful, soft and light, a little prim, not fast and not sporty. Small, dainty, bouncy steps landing lightly almost on her toes, feet close together; her lower legs flick outward to the SIDES behind her with each step; knees close together; upper body upright, shoulders soft; elbows bent and tucked in at her waist, forearms a little out to the sides, hands loose and floppy at the wrist, fluttering side to side rather than forward and back; hips and shoulders sway gently; hair and skirt bounce softly with every little step; moderate speed, hurrying.

[Acting] Mai: frightened but determined, hurrying, never looking back in this shot. Classic animation principles: weight in each step, follow-through on her hair, skirt and backpack.

[Character Look] Mai's skin is fair and light as in the reference; the teal light only tints her rim.
[Expression] Not readable from this height; no screaming.

[Lighting] Dark tunnel; a strong cool pale-cyan light pours from the far end of the tunnel (top of the frame) down the path toward the camera, casting Mai's long shadow toward the bottom of the frame; soft teal glow from the floating monitors along the walls; deep shadows in the root walls.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom). Child 6-6.5 heads tall. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: Mai's light quick footsteps echoing in the tunnel, her soft hurried breathing, the deep electric hum of the tunnel, faint whooshes of monitors drifting past, a low distant rumble. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] smoke, steam, mist, dust or a vapour trail behind Mai, under her feet or anywhere along the path; a white plume or column of smoke; the wolf, villains, other people; any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, timecode, captions, scene labels or logos anywhere, including on the monitors; faces on the monitors; Mai large or close to camera; an eye-level or low angle; Mai running toward camera; slow motion, freeze frame; cuts or a second shot; mixed art styles, 2D or sketch-like characters, realistic photographic humans; athletic or sprinter running, pumping arms; hoodie, chibi; dark or grey skin; studio or film names.
